resources.string: Lets TelePoint lock this financed device when your EMI is overdue. The lock screen shows your amount due and store contact. You can review this permission anytime in Settings.

Owner-authorised protection for this financed phone. While the EMI is outstanding it deters removal or wiping of the TelePoint app. It does not read or store your screen content. Device Owner remains the guaranteed block. Turn it off after the loan is fully paid.
